schemaVersion.description: Test definition format version. Use 1; if omitted, version 1 is assumed.

enabled.description: Whether this saved test can be run. Defaults to true; set false to keep the definition without running it.

id.description: Stable identifier for this test. If omitted, the ID is derived from its path under the tests directory.

name.description: Human-readable test name shown in test lists and results. If omitted, the filename is turned into a name.

appId.description: ID of the app this test runs against. It must match the app linked to the workspace.

taskId.description: Repository task to run. Without prompt, runs deterministically with no agent; with prompt, the agent is instructed to run the task. Target compatibility is checked before execution.

taskInput.description: Input arguments for a task-only test. Validated against the task input schema before launch. Only supported when prompt is omitted.

hintTasks.description: Optional repository task IDs suggested to the agent and preloaded ahead of search matches. Hints do not bypass starting-state, scope, or assertion checks.

prompt.description: Actions and observable checks for the agent, in order. Omit when taskId should run directly without an agent. Supports @task/ID and @selector/ID references.

validation.description: Optional additional checks. Checks can also be written directly in prompt. Use a validation string, or an object with a prompt, assertions, or both.

prompt.description: Instructions for checking whether the final app state satisfies the test.

assertions.description: Specific outcomes the agent must verify after the scenario. Provide at least one when there is no validation prompt.

requiredSecrets.description: Secret aliases needed by this test at run time. Each alias is resolved from the app-scoped secret store first, then from an environment variable with the same name.
